10.2 Interest Rates and Monetary Policy
This section explores three issues: (1) the connection between interest rate policies
and price level determinacy (in chapter 8, the new Keynesian model was used to explore issues of determinacy, but this related to the existence of a unique rationalexpectations equilibrium for the inflation rate, not the price level); (2) interest rate
policies in flexible-price general equilibrium models; and (3) the implications of liquidity traps.
1. Monetary policy operating procedures are discussed in chapter 11.
